OAK Beauty dùng một cookie phiên duy nhấ: OAK Beauty uses a single session cookie to remember that you are signed in. It is a strictly necessary technical cookie: without it, you would have to sign in again on every page.

OAK Beauty chỉ thu thập dữ liệu cần thiế: OAK Beauty collects only the data a booking needs. See what we keep, what we use it for, who we share it with and how much of it stays in your hands.
Cơ sở pháp lý: chúng tôi xử lý dữ liệu c: Legal basis: we process your data on the consent you give when you create an account, and on the performance of the booking agreement between you and the salon, under Vietnam’s Personal Data Protection Law 2025 and its implementing decrees.
Bài viết trên Blog có thể nhúng video từ: Blog articles may embed video from YouTube (Google). When you open such an article, YouTube may set cookies of its own in your browser; those follow Google’s policy and are outside the scope of OAK Beauty’s cookies.
Dữ liệu của bạn được lưu tại Supabase (h: Your data is stored with Supabase (Amazon Web Services infrastructure, Singapore region) and processed by an application server hosted at Render. That means your personal data is transferred and stored outside Vietnam; we do so under the cross-border transfer rules of the Personal Data Protection Law 2025.
Mật khẩu luôn được băm trước khi lưu. Qu: Passwords are always hashed before storage. Access to customer data is limited to the staff who need it to operate and support the platform.
Thời hạn lưu: lịch hẹn và đánh giá được: Retention: appointments and reviews are kept while your account is active and for up to 24 months after you close it, so history can be looked up and complaints resolved; technical logs (sessions, access times) are kept for 90 days; anonymous usage data is not tied to you and is kept for statistics.

Ngoài dữ liệu tài khoản ở mục 1, chúng t: Beyond the account data in section 1, we also process:
họ tên, ảnh chân dung, lời tự giới thiệu: your full name, your portrait, the introduction you write about yourself and the portfolio photos you upload.
các salon bạn từng có dòng nhân sự, ngày: the salons where you have held a staff record, the start date and end date at each of them, and the confirmation status of every one of those dates.
số lượt hẹn đã hoàn thành tách theo cách: the number of completed appointments broken down by how each was recorded, the number of reviews and the average score customers have left.
gộp toàn bộ những dữ liệu trên vào một t: to bring all of the data above onto a single public profile page, so that your craft can be seen as one continuous record across several salons rather than lying scattered at each of them. This is public data in the full sense of the word: anyone holding the link can read it, signed in or not, and search engines may index the page.
sự đồng ý bạn đưa ra khi tạo tài khoản v: the consent you give when you create the account and when you fill in your own half of the profile, under the Personal Data Protection Law 2025. If you signed up yourself and have taken over no profile at any salon, that consent is the only basis; once you take over a profile at a salon, the work history at that salon additionally rests on the performance of the agreement between you and the salon. The operational half of the staff record — the name on the staff list, the job title, the specialty, the work schedule and the customer reviews left — is entered by the salon and belongs to that salon's business records.

Sau khi xóa tài khoản, hồ sơ kinh doanh: Once the account is deleted, the salon's business records are still kept: the name on the staff list, the job title, the customer reviews left at the salon and the record of the appointments served. This is the data a salon needs in order to look up its history and settle complaints, held for exactly the retention period in section 4. The boundary is this: you can withdraw what you wrote about yourself, and you cannot withdraw what the salon recorded about the work.
